title: DocEnhance command response
description: Emitted from actual typed Fields and compiled discovery descriptors.

const.name: --json
const.description: Render one JSON response on stdout and nothing on stderr.

const.name: --help
const.description: Render help without opening input or creating output.

const.name: --version
const.description: Human-readable alias of the version command.

const.name: --out-dir
const.description: New result directory; its parent must exist and it is never replaced.

const.name: --output-mode
const.description: Preserve keeps the decoded gray/color category, not source bytes, ICC space, metadata or alpha. All modes share interpretation, geometry and the fixed photometric stages. Gray quantizes final linear luminance; bw classifies terminal sRGB Q16 samples and writes physical 1-bit PNG.

const.name: --bit-depth
const.description: Continuous output depth; auto keeps 16-bit source precision, otherwise 8.

const.name: --alpha
const.description: Composite alpha over white or black in linear light, or reject any non-opaque pixel.

const.name: --profile-policy
const.description: Interpret supported colour declarations, or override them with sRGB.

const.name: --rotate
const.description: Exact clockwise quarter-turn after metadata orientation, in every output mode.

const.name: --protect-mask
const.description: 1/8-bit gray PNG in metadata-oriented source dimensions; non-zero samples protect photometric stages. Binarization still classifies every pixel.

const.name: --threads
const.description: Maximum scheduler workers; auto uses detected concurrency bounded to 1..256. Execution settings are response diagnostics, not persistent method configuration.

const.name: --memory-limit
const.description: One charged processing budget in MiB for snapshots, interpretation, methods, encoding and publication. Charged bytes are not a process-RSS limit; verification retains its separate fixed budget.

const.name: --json
const.description: Render one JSON response on stdout and nothing on stderr.

const.name: --help
const.description: Render help without opening input or creating output.

const.name: --illumination
const.description: Select illumination

const.name: --background-strength
const.description: Exponent applied to the illumination gain; 0 is an exact no-op.

const.name: --background-max-gain
const.description: Largest multiplicative gain applied to any sample; 1 is an exact no-op.

const.name: --background-target
const.description: Linear-light target; 'source' uses the fitted background's nearest-rank 90th percentile.

const.name: --background-cell
const.description: Cell edge in processing pixels.

const.name: --background-quantile
const.description: Nearest-rank quantile of eligible cell samples.

const.name: --background-smooth
const.description: Grid-Laplacian weight of the logarithmic background fit.

const.name: --background-radius
const.description: Square closing radius in processing pixels; Gaussian sigma = max(0.5, radius/2).

const.name: --denoise
const.description: Select denoising

const.name: --denoise-blend
const.description: Blend in perceptual luminance; 0 keeps entering samples.

const.name: --nlm-h
const.description: Filter strength in equivalent 8-bit perceptual points; higher values may remove marks.

const.name: --nlm-patch
const.description: Square patch width.

const.name: --nlm-search
const.description: Square search width; at least the patch width.

const.name: --tv-lambda
const.description: L1 fidelity weight; larger values smooth less.

const.name: --tv-iterations
const.description: Iteration cap; exhaustion keeps the iterate and warns.

const.name: --tv-tolerance
const.description: Primal and dual update tolerance at two consecutive checkpoints.

const.name: --deblur
const.description: Select restoration

const.name: --psf
const.description: Point-spread function model in the processing frame.

const.name: --psf-sigma
const.description: Gaussian standard deviation in pixels.

const.name: --psf-length
const.description: Motion segment length in pixels.

const.name: --psf-angle
const.description: Motion direction, degrees clockwise from +x in y-down coordinates.

const.name: --psf-file
const.description: Grayscale PNG of raw non-negative coefficients, odd sides 3..129.

const.name: --wiener-k
const.description: Positive regularizer in |H|^2+K; not a measured noise ratio.

const.name: --deblur-blend
const.description: Blend of entering and restored linear luminance before clamping.

const.name: --contrast
const.description: Select contrast

const.name: --contrast-blend
const.description: Blend in perceptual luminance; 0 keeps entering samples.

const.name: --levels-low
const.description: Nearest-rank lower percentile of unprotected perceptual samples.

const.name: --levels-high
const.description: Nearest-rank upper percentile; greater than the lower one.

const.name: --gamma
const.description: f' = f^G; above 1 darkens midtones; 1 is an exact identity.

const.name: --clahe-grid
const.description: Contextual columns x rows; every tile at least 16 pixels per side.

const.name: --clahe-clip
const.description: Pre-redistribution clip multiplier relative to mean occupancy.

const.name: --sharpen
const.description: Select sharpening

const.name: --sharpen-sigma
const.description: Gaussian standard deviation in pixels.

const.name: --sharpen-amount
const.description: Soft-thresholded high-pass gain; 0 is an exact identity.

const.name: --sharpen-threshold
const.description: Soft threshold in equivalent 8-bit perceptual points.

const.name: --binarize
const.description: Select binarization

const.name: --sauvola-window
const.description: Centred square window with REFLECT_101 borders.

const.name: --sauvola-k
const.description: Weight in T = m*(1 + k*(s/R - 1)).

const.name: --sauvola-r
const.description: Normalized deviation scale.

const.name: --fixed-threshold
const.description: Black iff the normalized terminal Q16 code is at most T.
